question: How do I register for courses?
answer: Open the Courses page, review the available course codes, and follow the registration instructions shared by your academic department during the enrollment window.

question: Where can I find campus event details?
answer: Use the Events link in the main navigation to see all upcoming university technical fests, cultural nights, workshops, and sports meets with full registration links.

question: How do I update my student profile?
answer: Visit the Profile page from your student dashboard. You can review your details and contact the helpdesk if any official college record requires updating.

question: Who can help with fee or attendance questions?
answer: Contact your department coordinator or use the Fees and Attendance pages in the Student Hub dashboard for your real-time academic records.

question: What are the Central Library working hours?
answer: The Central Library is open Monday to Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM, and extended until 9:00 PM during mid-semester and end-semester examination weeks.

question: How do I reset my portal password?
answer: Go to Dashboard > Settings > Change Password, or reach out to the Student Helpdesk at studenthub@gmail.com with your student ID.
